name: query
description: Run one SELECT on the database with bound parameters ($1, $2, ...). Call describe first when you have not seen the schema yet, so you use the right table and column names. Runs read-only, within the engine's time limit and row limit. The read is recorded as a change record (in the run when runId is given), with the version of each row the engine can identify, so a later write in the run to a row changed since is refused with STALE_READ. Multiple statements, locking reads and functions outside the allowlist are refused. A refusal, or a warning such as RLS_HIDES_ROWS, carries nextSteps: do them in order, and show personMessage verbatim.

runId.description: The run this read belongs to, from run_start.

changeId.description: The change record of this read.

type.description: The store's type name (Postgres: int8, text, timestamptz).

rows.description: One object per row, keyed by field name as the store returns it.

warnings.description: Planned (CONTRACT.md, Next steps): warnings about a result that worked but is probably not what the agent expects (RLS_HIDES_ROWS). Absent when empty.
